subject: [hw] IV -> V41: three encode-path gaps proven with the real daemon (fds, async done, AP power); API proposal + exact patches
body:
With a /tmp copy of V41 (plus the V40 VMA and V34 foreign-share fixes) the real vpud now reaches the VENC: 55 register writes and wait_irq(RWVC_IRQ_VENC, 1000). Three issues are in n2ap_venc.c / n2vc_dma.c, all visible in the trace:

1. The daemon needs dma-buf fds, not 0. vpud ringbuf does ion_import(msg.input_fd[0] / msg.bs_fd); with 0 it logs "[ERROR] ion_import failed, ion_buf_fd = 0 LINE: 101" and answers ENCODE_DONE status 0 with bs_size 0. With two shares registered by the AP (V34 n2shim_ion_register_share) and msg.input_fd[0]=0x500, msg.bs_fd=0x501 the import succeeds. Proposal (backward compatible):
     int n2ap_venc_encode_fd(struct n2ap_venc *e, uint32_t frame_handle, int frame_fd,
                             uint32_t bs_handle, int bs_fd, unsigned flags,
                             struct n2ap_enc_result *res);
   n2ap_venc_encode() calls it with 0/0. Only the two message fields differ.

2. n2ap_venc_encode() returns at the ACK (0xD005), but the daemon finishes asynchronously: it sends POWER_ON, WAIT_ISR and PUT_BUFFER afterwards. The size/key lives in vsi->list_free per your own comment. The runner needs a bounded wait, e.g.:
     int n2ap_venc_wait_done(struct n2ap_venc *e, unsigned timeout_ms, struct n2ap_enc_result *res);
   waiting under reply_lock (or polling it) until e->nfreed > 0, then filling bytes/key. In the /tmp build PUT_BUFFER arrives (ap put_buffer a=1) but its bs_va did not match the cookie V41 wrote (e->vsi->venc.venc_bs_va = 0x... guest address); please check which cookie the daemon echoes back. I can send the freed entry contents if useful.

3. The AP must power the VENC before a job. The kernel does mtk_vcodec_enc_clock_on() in venc_encode_prepare() when the daemon sends VCU_IPIMSG_ENC_POWER_ON (venc_vcu_if.c:135-148). This daemon never sends POWER_ON; it writes registers directly (the real firmware expects the AP clocks already on). With hw->power(VENC/VENC_C1,1) before the encode (runner-side in /tmp) the GCE write at VENC 0x00a8 succeeds and the whole sequence runs. Please either call ven_power_ref(e,1) around encode or expose n2ap_venc_power(e,on) for the runner/daemon. Note the fake returned EACCES on the first write until powered.

4. (n2vc_dma.c) n2vc_dma_guest_unmap() clears an entry even when owns=0; the daemon's ion_munmap after the first job removes the AP-owned frame/bs handles, so the next encode returns -EINVAL before it even sends. Minimal fix: for !owns, keep the entry (return 0), as the AP still owns the handle and syncs through the same guest mapping.

Evidence (all host, no phone): full trace in /tmp/n2hw-iv/fdrun10 (not in the tree); last lines: N2VHOST M-f wait_irq... reached; hw venc_ops=55 regs_calls=6. The current tree (without these /tmp patches) reaches M-d with n2ap_venc_open=0. Which of these do you want in your file? If you are done/inactive I will ask root to let me apply the minimal versions and record them as IV-owned carry patches.
